text: Figure 9.75: Interfaces of UCM Master Name: VehiclePackageManagement Technology: ara::com service interface Usage: Public API Description: This interface provides functionality for managing and transferring Vehicle Package s and Software Package s to UCM Master . AllowCampaign Allows a new campaign to start. CancelCampaign Aborts an ongoing campaign processing of a Vehicle Package. DeleteT ransfer Delete a transferred Software Package or Vehicle Package. GetCampaignHistory Retrieve all actions that have been performed by UCM Master. GetSwClusterInfo Get a list of SoftwareClusters that are in state k Present. GetSwPackages Get the Software Package s that are part of current campaign handled by UCM Master . SwPackageInventory Performs an inventory of all Software Package s. Operations: T ransferData Block-wise transfer of a Software Package or Vehicle Package to UCM Master . ▽
